title: Resource Allocation
alt: Resource Allocation Area State Diagram showing operational states and transitions
description:
Resource Allocation Logic

The Resource Allocation Area controls the mixing and preparation of dough ingredients.

Control Logic Flow:
  • Conveyor 2 Control: When ps1 = 0 and ps2 = 0, set c2 = 1. Count for 2 seconds, then set c2 = 0 and ps2 = 1.
  • Conveyor 2 Pusher: When ps2 = 1, count for 7.5 to 15.0 seconds. After the time interval, set ps2 = 0 and ps3 = 1 to advance to the next stage.
  • This stage ensures proper material allocation and mixing before moving product to finished goods area.

title: Production Area
alt: Production Area State Diagram showing operational states and transitions
description:
Production Area Logic

The Production Area manages the flow of cookies through dough forming, cutting, and freezing processes.

Control Logic Flow:
  • Boxing Machine Control: When c1 = 0 and ps2 = 0, initiate boxing = 1. The system counts for 2 seconds if boxing = 1 and box_maker = 1. After 2 seconds, reset boxing to 0.
  • Conveyor 1 Control: When boxing = 0, ps2 = 0, and ps1 = 0, set c1 = 1. Count for 3 seconds, then set c1 = 0 and ps1 = 1.
  • Conveyor 1 Pusher: When ps1 = 1 and bagger is active, count for 1 second. After 1 second, reset ps1 to 0.

title: Boxing & Taping
alt: Boxing and Taping Machine State Diagram showing operational states and transitions
description:
Boxing & Taping Machine Logic

The Boxing Machine packages cookies into individual boxes while the Taping Machine seals them securely for transport.

Control Logic Flow:
  • Conveyor 3 Control: When ps3 = 1, ps5 = 0, and ps4 = 0, set c3 = 1 and ps3 = 0. Count for 3 seconds, then set c3 = 0 and ps4 = 1.
  • Conveyor 3 Pusher: When ps4 = 1 and taper = 1, count for 2 seconds. After 2 seconds, set ps4 = 0.
  • Taping Process: The taping machine is synchronized with the boxing machine through the ps4 control signal.
  • Coordination: When the boxing machine finishes (ps4 = 0), the taping machine can proceed with sealing operations.
  • The boxing and taping processes work together to ensure secure packaging before moving to the palletizer.

title: Palletizer
alt: Palletizer State Diagram showing operational states and transitions
description:
Palletizer Logic

The Palletizer stacks and organizes finished boxes for shipping.

Control Logic Flow:
  • Conveyor 4 Control: When ps4 = 0 and ps5 = 0, set c4 = 1. Count for 4 seconds, then set c4 = 0 and ps5 = 1.
  • Palletizer Grab Logic: When palletizer_grabbing = 1 and palletizer_pos = 2, set palletizer_grabbing = 0 and increment box_count by 1.
  • Wrapping Trigger: When box_count = 40 and wrapper = 1, set wrapper_wrapping = 1 to begin wrapping the full pallet.
  • When ps6 = 1, activate conveyor_5 for final product movement.

title: Wrapping Machine
alt: Wrapping Machine State Diagram showing operational states and transitions
description:
Wrapping Machine Logic

The Wrapping Machine applies protective wrapping to pallets for shipping.

Control Logic Flow:
  • Pallet Wrapping Initiation: When box_count reaches 40 and wrapper = 1, the wrapping operation begins (wrapper_wrapping = 1).
  • Final Conveyor: When ps6 = 1, conveyor_5 is activated to move wrapped pallets to storage or shipping.
  • Completion: The wrapping process ensures pallets are protected during storage and transportation.
  • This is the final stage in the cookie manufacturing sequence before product distribution.
